## 2026-01-30 - Navigation in Text Reports
**Learning:** Users treat long Markdown reports like web pages and expect "Back to Top" links and Table of Contents to navigate efficiently. Emojis in headers serve as visual anchors that speed up scanning.
**Action:** Standardize all CLI-generated Markdown reports to include an auto-generated Table of Contents, explicit HTML anchors for stable linking, and "Back to Top" navigation loops.
